Ivy (CSM): LotusAI needs a short per-route QPS lift + CIDR allowlist for a Brazil trial tomorrow 09:30 BRT. Can we do hosted-only, per-route overrides and autorevoke after 4h?
Rafael (LotusAI): Yes. Routes: POST /v1/complete 120->800 qps, /v1/stream 80->500 qps for 4h. Source CIDRs: 191.2.64.0/22 and 191.2.68.0/22. ASN 64911. We'll pin to sa-east-1. Renewal rep will use this launch as an engagement point.
Nadia (NetEng): Per-route window fine. I'll name window lotus-bz-trial-4809 and tag customer-temp,autorevoke. Will run staging smoke and request traceroute from ASN 64911.
Omar (Oncall): Monitoring hooks: alert if 5xx > 0.8% for 5m or P95 > 900ms. Rollback policy: immediate revert if error budget >2% in first 10m. I'll prepare commands.
peering-bot: peering-bot: Peering pre-check started for LotusAI (ASN 64911). Waiting traceroute sample.
Rafael (LotusAI): Traceroute attached (trimmed). Ramp plan: 10% -> 40% -> 100% over 25 minutes. Auto-revoke at 13:30 UTC.
Nadia (NetEng): Staging done. Staging command used: redwoodctl rate-window create --name lotus-bz-trial-4809 --cidrs 191.2.64.0/22,191.2.68.0/22 --routes /v1/complete=800,/v1/stream=500 --region sa-east-1 --start 2026-04-10T09:30:00-03:00 --end 2026-04-10T13:30:00Z --tags customer-temp,lotusai,autorevoke
Ivy (CSM): Thanks. Action items: Nadia -> prod push 15m before start, Omar -> monitor + rollback readiness, Rafael -> confirm traceroute. I'll schedule renewal outreach next week. :rocket:
